facts.excerpt: Tower Bridge’s iconic Towers, High-Level Walkways and Victorian Engine Rooms and find out why the attraction has become one of the most popular things to do for visitors to the city. Why visit Tower Bridge? Tower Bridge is an architectural icon and one of London’s most famous attractions. Designed and built in Victorian times, it was the largest and most sophisticated bascule bridge ever completed when it opened in 1894, and it still endures more than 130 years later. Explore this iconic London landmark on a self-guided tour, or join one of the expert-led guided tours to hear fascinating insights and anecdotes, as you visit Tower Bridge’s famous Towers, East and West Walk
